note: FINDINGS-2026-08-17 item D.1: `nestor ask "hi" --db x.db` fails with 'unrecognized arguments' because argparse requires global flags before the subcommand. Agents and new users learn the pattern from `ui`/`serve` (which special-case it) and hit this wall on every other command.

decisions.question: How should the CLI handle global flags (--db, --ledger, --json) placed after the subcommand?
decisions.commitment: A new `_hoist_globals()` function rewrites sys.argv to move the three global flags before the subcommand, so `nestor ask "hi" --db x.db` and `nestor triage --json` work regardless of flag position. The existing `_HintingParser` stays as a safety net for any flags not yet hoisted.
decisions.why: This was the single highest-frequency failure any new human or agent would hit, and the cheapest to fix. No design tradeoff — the flags are unambiguously global and have no subcommand-level name collision.
